takeaway: Raised intracranial pressure with bitemporal hemianopia, from tumour pressure on the optic chiasm, is the characteristic presentation of a pituitary adenoma; large tumours can also involve the 3rd, 4th and 6th cranial nerves.

layers.text: 2 · It presses on the optic chiasm
